turn.turnBoundary: After the party spends the night at the inn; in-game only
turn.dmFocus: What might the local factions do while the party rests?

approvedFacts.text: The wardens' stated duty is to protect travelers and keep the bridge open.
The smugglers' crates were hidden before the party returned to town.

uncertainties.text: There is no evidence that the wardens suspect the party.

sources.excerpt: Keep the bridge open and protect travelers.
The crates were hidden before the party returned to town.
No faction action has been approved for this in-game turn.

factions.name: Bridge Wardens
factions.goal: Keep the bridge open and protect travelers.
constraints: They cannot leave the bridge unguarded.

factions.name: Reedbank smugglers
factions.goal: Move the hidden crates without drawing attention.
constraints: The amount of cargo is not established.

clocks.name: Warden scrutiny
clocks.description: How closely the wardens inspect suspicious traffic.

clocks.name: Crates moved
clocks.description: Progress toward moving the hidden cargo.

proposals.action: A patrol asks travelers a few extra questions at the bridge.
proposals.rationale: A visible, limited response fits the wardens' stated duty.
costs: Proposed use of one patrol team; do not deduct it.
visibleSigns: A notice asks for reports of unusual cargo.
alternativeResponses: The DM may keep the wardens' routine unchanged.
The party may ask the warden what prompted the questions.
uncertainties: No evidence links the party to the hidden crates.

changes.reason: A more attentive patrol could increase scrutiny if approved.

proposals.action: The smugglers wait for a quieter opportunity rather than move cargo now.
proposals.rationale: The amount of cargo and their available labor are unknown.
costs: No resource use is established; none is proposed as spent.
visibleSigns: No new movement is visible; a covered cart remains nearby.
alternativeResponses: The DM may leave the smugglers' activity unresolved.
The party may investigate the cart or ignore it.

notes: Fictional example only; no action or clock change is approved.
